title: UneceMetricCharacteristic
description: A prominent attribute or aspect of a metric (a standard of measurement).

contentTypeCode.description: The code specifying the content type of this metric characteristic.

description.description: A textual description of this metric characteristic.

identifier.description: An identifier of this metric characteristic.

metricCharacteristicValueCode.description: The code specifying the value of this metric characteristic.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of metric characteristic.

value.description: A value, expressed as text, for this metric characteristic.

valueAmount.description: The monetary value for this metric characteristic.

valueDateTime.description: The value for this metric characteristic, expressed as a date, time, date time, or other date time value.

valueIndicator.description: The value for this metric characteristic expressed as an indicator.

valueMeasure.description: A measure of a value for this metric characteristic.

valueMethod.description: A method specified for a value of this metric characteristic.

valueNumeric.description: The value, expressed as a number, for this metric characteristic.

valueParameter.description: A parameter specified for a value for this metric characteristic.

valueQuantity.description: The value, expressed as a quantity, for this metric characteristic.

valueRange.description: A range specified for a value of this metric characteristic.

valueTolerance.description: A tolerance specified for a value of this metric characteristic.
